title: Delayed Retirement, Intergenerational Transfers, and Fertility
abstract: arXiv:2610.32455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Population aging and fertility decline are occurring simultaneously worldwide, straining labor supply and pension systems. China began a gradual delayed-retirement (GDR) reform in 2025, raising statutory retirement ages on different schedules for men, female cadres, and female workers across birth cohorts. To evaluate its effects on older individuals and within the family, we develop a model of older adults' retirement, intergenerational transfers, and adult children's fertility decisions, with parameters estimated via fuzzy regression discontinuity at the pre-2025 statutory retirement ages. Counterfactual simulations show that, for mature reform cohorts, the GDR reform increases older employment and monetary transfers to adult children but reduces grandparental childcare. translated_title: 延迟退休、代际转移与生育率
translated_abstract: 人口老龄化与生育率下降正在全球范围内同时发生，给劳动力供给和养老金体系带来压力。中国于2025年开始实施渐进式延迟退休改革，针对不同出生队列的男性、女性干部和女性工人，按不同时间表提高法定退休年龄。为评估该改革对老年人个体及家庭内部的影响，我们构建了一个涵盖老年人退休决策、代际转移以及成年子女生育决策的模型，并通过在2025年前法定退休年龄处的模糊断点回归方法估计模型参数。反事实模拟显示，对于改革充分实施的队列而言，渐进式延迟退休改革提高了老年人的就业水平和给予成年子女的货币转移，但减少了祖辈提供的隔代照料。由于照料时间的减少超过了货币转移的增加，生育率和老年人的福利均出现下降，其中低收入群体的损失尤为显著。
tldr: 本文构建了涵盖老年人退休、代际转移与成年子女生育决策的模型，发现中国的渐进式延迟退休改革虽提高了老年人就业和对子女的货币转移，但因隔代照料减少幅度更大，最终导致生育率和老年人福利双双下降。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a model of older adults' retirement, intergenerational transfers, and adult children's fertility, showing that China's gradual delayed-retirement reform increases older employment and monetary transfers but reduces grandparental childcare by more, ultimately lowering both fertility and older adults' welfare, with the largest losses among lower-income households.
